title: Rated-Period Retention on Named Driver Exclusions, Cardinal Personal Auto Policy Rate Page
content:
For a household member excluded from a Cardinal Personal Auto Policy, the exclusion credit is taken at a retention share. The share follows how long the excluded driver was rated.

| Days the excluded driver was rated | Retention share |
|---|---|
| Fewer than 90 | Three quarters (0.75) |
| 90 or more but fewer than 180 | Nine tenths (0.9) |
| 180 or more | One |

**How the days are counted.** In calendar days, from the effective date of that driver's addition (the driver's latest driver addition entry in the policy's transaction history) to the day the form is signed.

## Edges (hypothetical; addition effective 1 January 2026)

| Form signed | Days rated | Retention share |
|---|---|---|
| 31 March 2026 | 89 | 0.75 |
| 1 April 2026 | 90 | 0.9 |
| 29 June 2026 | 179 | 0.9 |
| 30 June 2026 | 180 | One |

**Illustration (hypothetical).** For a credit base of 120.00, a driver rated 89 days is credited at 0.75, which is 90.00. A driver rated 150 days is credited at 0.9, which is 108.00.
